entities.summary: Shen Wansan was a prominent businessman during the early Ming Dynasty (1368-1644), playing a crucial role in shaping the economic landscape of China. He was born in unknown circumstances and died in 1379. Shen Wansan's legacy is complex, as he both contributed to the growth of trade and invested in infrastructure projects. His influence can be seen in the development of the silk road and the establishment of the Ming Dynasty's economic policies. He was also known for his involvement in the governance of the city of Nanjing, where he held a position of authority. Shen Wansan's impact on Chinese history was significant, as he helped to establish the Ming Dynasty as a major economic power. He was a key figure in the development of the city of Nanjing and played a crucial role in the growth of trade in the region. His legacy can still be seen in the modern-day city of Nanjing, where he is remembered as a key figure in the city's history. As one historian noted, 'Shen Wansan's entrepreneurial spirit and vision for the future of China helped to shape the course of the Ming Dynasty.'
